items: The main purpose of a GUI in Python programming is to: (a) Create a user-friendly interface for interacting with software (b) Manage files in Python (c) Handle network operations (d) Store and retrieve data from databases
Python's built-in GUI toolkit is: (a) wxPython (b) Tkinter (c) PyQt (d) Kivy
The Tkinter widget used to display text is: (a) Button (b) Label (c) Entry (d) Listbox
The pack() method in Tkinter is used to: (a) Align widgets vertically or horizontally (b) Organize widgets in rows and columns (c) Set widget sizes manually (d) Create pop-up windows
The methods used to organize widgets in Tkinter include: (a) grid() (b) pack() (c) place() (d) All of the above

Event-driven programming in Tkinter means: (a) Writing code that runs without user input (b) Writing code that responds to user actions such as clicks or key presses (c) Writing code to manage database queries (d) Writing code to handle network requests
The Tkinter widget used to get user input is: (a) Label (b) Button (c) Entry (d) Listbox
The Tkinter layout manager that allows precise positioning of widgets using coordinates is: (a) pack() (b) grid() (c) place() (d) align()
The Tkinter option that connects a button click to a function is: (a) bind() (b) configure() (c) command= (no parentheses) (d) execute()
CRUD operations in databases stand for: (a) Create, Read, Update, Delete (b) Create, Run, Upload, Delete (c) Copy, Retrieve, Upload, Download (d) Create, Remove, Update, Manage
